item.title: Circa 1786 in Connecticut! Love those wide floorboards! $279,000
item.description: I love the wide floorboards in this house! Great fireplaces too! The house was built in 1786. It is located on .29 acre in East Hartford, Connecticut. The house features wide floorboards, built-in bookshelves, chair rails, crown moulding, large fireplaces, spacious kitchen and a lot of natural light. There is a large detached garage on the property that has unfinished space above. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,491 square feet. $279,000 Contact Tatiana Cozar with Coldwell Banker Realty: 203

item.title: Ohio’s most expensive old house listing! Riverstone Farm on 77 acres. $4,400,000
item.description: Welcome to Ohio’s most expensive old house listing! Riverstone Farm is beautiful! It started off as a hunting lodge and summer home for wealthy industrialist, Frederic H. Chaplin. Riverstone Farm was built in 1940. It is located on 77 acres in Willoughby, Ohio. The property includes a 3/4 mile driveway, a main house, “Chapin’s Lodge”, a two story guest house, a two story studio barn and a four stall horse barn. Five bedrooms, five bathrooms and 7,600 square feet. $4,400,000 From the Zillow listi

item.title: Beautiful Ocracoke in the Outer Banks of North Carolina. C. 1883. $550,000
item.description: Ocracoke is one of the barrier islands of the Outer Banks. It is only accessible by ferry. It’s a beautiful place! This house is known as Tom Frank Gaskins House. It was built in 1883. The house is located in Ocracoke, North Carolina. The house features a cedar shake shingle exterior, a screened in porch, tongue and groove walls, wood floors, great kitchen sink and a claw foot tub. It’s nice that the house has already been raised. item.title: Nice floors! Large unfinished basement. C. 1947 in North Carolina. $249,000
item.description: This house has nice floors! There is a large unfinished basement. The house was built in 1947. It is located on .59 acre in Millers Creek, North Carolina. The house features a carport, a small covered porch, a large back porch, arched entryway, wood floors, baseboards and a brick fireplace. There is an enclosed back porch that has been converted into a laundry room. The home has a large unfinished basement that is perfect for storage. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,702 square feet. $249,000

item.title: Pretty house! Circa 1900 in Virginia. $245,000
item.description: This is a great house! Pretty details inside! The house was built in 1900. It is located on .75 acre in McDowell, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, white picket fence, wood floors, crown moulding, brick fireplace, wide baseboards, chair rails, wainscoting, a lot of natural light and built-in bookshelves. There is a large back deck and a fire pit area. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,184 square feet. $245,000 Contact Hearthstone Realty Group with Nest Realty Group Staunton:

item.title: Pretty setting! Love the long driveway! Almost four acres in Kentucky. $345,970
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! I love the long driveway! The house was built in 1859. It is located on 3.78 acres in Horse Cave, Kentucky. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,255 square feet. $345,970 Contact Erica Puckett with Legacy Property Group: 270-528-6965 From the Zillow listing: Country Liv

item.title: On 44 acres in Maine! Love the greenhouse! C. 1939. $239,000
item.description: Nice acreage with this house! I love that greenhouse! The home was built in 1939. It is located on 44 acres in Burlington, Vermont. The house could use some updating, but it has some nice features to work with. The home features a large deck, a large great room with vaulted ceiling, wood floors and a built-in corner cabinet.
